name: Pack distinct multiples of a fixed integer set
description: construct() -> ten DISTINCT positive Python integers <=1000000, aligned with the pinned input [6,10,14,15,21,22,26,33,35,39]. Each representative must be divisible by its corresponding input. Minimize max(representatives)-min(representatives), the length of their closed enclosing interval. The bank’s full-matching minimum-span question is used literally for one fixed ten-element input and a representative cap. The cited related paper instead optimizes guaranteed partial cardinality in every fixed-length interval. Its theorem is not evidence of a solution or precise importance classification for this changed objective.

sources.locator: Wouter van Doorn, Yanyang Li and Quanyu Tang, Optimal bounds for an Erdős problem on matching integers to distinct multiples (2026). Section 1 defines divisibility matching of an arbitrary finite A into interval integers. The main result determines guaranteed PARTIAL matching cardinality in every open interval of length twice max(A).
JSP-000578; pinned revision bcf1866ea9a4ae82b32bd95b82ffd812b9ee80d2. Independently paraphrased finite adaptation; catalog contributor claims are not accepted as proof.
